summary: Backups must be complete and atomic; WordPress mutations must never replay automatically or disappear from impact history after ambiguous outcomes.
reason: Plugin collection contracts differ from generic REST pagination. Preview and failure paths must preserve existing files, and field intents must survive transport, verification, and snapshot failures without storing values.
validated_outcome: Regression coverage includes all four multi-page exports, backup preservation, committed HTTP 500 imports with configured idempotency keys, and field-intent impact after failed readback or snapshot finalization. Intent reconciliation indexes 10,000 completion pairs in linear journal passes while retaining strict linkage and unknown-outcome checks.
